_note: Owner R15 A (2026-11-14): each character's own words, checked by the gate. 'own': stems of the words that carry the character (a Day or Hour seat beat must use at least one). 'reserved': phrases that belong to this character alone (no other character's unit may use them). Matching is case-insensitive on word starts, so 'promis' covers promise, promises, promised. Sources: 子平真诠 论十神, 滴天髓 性情, and the personas in Reading/Database/Prompts/04_READING_SYSTEM_PRIMER.md.

Twin.stands_for: self-reliance, equals, standing on your own feet

Rival.stands_for: competition, sharing what you have, money that moves through friends

Artisan.stands_for: ease, appetite, making things, food and rest

Virtuoso.stands_for: a sharp voice, talent that rebels, saying what others won't

Horizon.stands_for: range, side doors, windfalls, openings far from home

Steward.stands_for: careful keeping, earned value, steady money and order at home

General.stands_for: pressure that forges, hard tests, a fight with real stakes

Magistrate.stands_for: rules, duty, a role, a word kept in public

Alchemist.stands_for: strange knowledge, private study, an unusual mind

Sage.stands_for: shelter, learning, being looked after and looking after
